storyCards.fact:
Niall Horan's "Slow Hands" reached #11 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Slow Hands" is a song recorded by Irish singer-songwriter Niall Horan, released as a single on 4 May 2017 by Capitol Records.

The song peaked at #11 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 31 weeks on the chart.

Slow Hands was released in 2017.
